scope: Prevent model evaluation metrics and activation eligibility from being reported on non-independent candidate-ID splits.

verification.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider backend/tests/test_learning_split.py backend/tests/test_learning_registry.py backend/tests/test_ground_truth_learning.py backend/tests/test_element_annotations.py backend/tests/test_api_pipeline.py -q --tb=short --basetemp <isolated-temp>
checks: valid physical holdout is recognized only when all rows have physical IDs and train/test IDs are disjoint
missing physical IDs make evaluation unverified
overlapping physical IDs make evaluation unverified
empty training split makes evaluation unverified
end-to-end training without physical IDs returns null accuracy and macro-F1 and cannot activate the candidate

acceptance.reason: The current independent physical annotation queue still has no verified engineer labels or real held-out physical instances.
